candidates.snippet: Over the past month, 6 Mbpd of the crude coming out of the SoH got held up in STS transfers. The process takes up too much of the bandwidth.

Yes, there are direct shipments which skip the STS process. Given the delay which STS transfers impose, direct shipments will be next big boost to come out of the region. Still a matter of risk appetite though but the charter rates may entice more to try. https://t.co/8SJnSdBCqH
